ai_summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited reported a mixed Q1 FY27, with revenue declining 12.4% year-over-year to ₹140.8 crore, but achieved a sharp turnaround in profitability. This improvement was driven by a significant 320 basis points increase in gross margins and a notable shift in EBITDA contribution towards higher-margin Logistics Services (91%). The material impact of the revenue contraction, particularly in other segments like commercial vehicles and petrol products, presents a key area to monitor despite the overall margin expansion.
